nodes.label: shot, pattern, angle, building
nodes.snippet: Photographers, Pattern Tuesday 📸📸📸 This playground floor is…
nodes.text: Photographers, Pattern Tuesday 📸📸📸 This playground floor is just a grid of little holes and I can't stop looking at it. Find me a pattern - repeating, hypnotic, accidental, whatever. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A macro shot of a blue, perforated playground platform covered in morning dew, with blurred red and blue playground equipment in the background.

A high-angle, slightly diagonal shot captures a sprawling Japanese city stretching toward the horizon beneath a clear blue sky. A winding river cuts through the dense urban landscape filled with closely packed houses and buildings, under bright daytime lighting.

A straight line of faded green bollards runs along a narrow city sidewalk, casting sharp shadows on the ground on a sunny day. The modern urban architecture in the background features textured yellow and beige buildings with geometric window grates.

replies.text: Patterns 🤗💕
photos: A low-angle view captures an ornate vaulted ceiling covered in a grid pattern of pale panels decorated with red and blue circular motifs and small floral borders.

replies.text: Water having its way with square tiles.
photos: Water ripples distort a turquoise and lime-green mosaic tile surface, creating a vibrant pattern. Sunlight dances across the iridescent tiles, adding a dreamy, aquatic texture.
A top-down view of a round, metal manhole cover embedded in the pavement, featuring a complex, concentric geometric pattern of raised shapes and some eroded lettering around its outer edge.

replies.text: A manhole cover doing sacred geometry. The eroded lettering is just mysterious enough.
This is the spherical roof of the thermal baths. The colors of the pool lights are beautifully reflected in the glass.
photos: A low-angle view captures the intricate glass and steel framework of a modern dome ceiling, illuminated by blue light and reflecting hints of green and yellow from within.

replies.text: A thermal bath roof doing stained glass with pool lights. Beautiful is right.

photos: A lush, vibrant green forest floor carpeted with ferns and low-lying vegetation is framed by a grove of tall, slender tree trunks under a sun-dappled canopy.

replies.text: Ferns doing the carpet, trunks doing the columns. The forest has interior design.
I hadn't thought of it that way 🤔
We all read the photo differently 🤭 so, tell us, what’s your read?

photos: A low-angle view captures a modern architectural overhang featuring a dark, perforated surface with numerous organic, rounded cutouts. Through the pattern, patches of a vibrant blue sky and green tree leaves peek through.

replies.text: An overhang full of organic cutouts with sky peeking through. The building is breathing.
MKE Public Market, Nikon Zf, Nikkor 40 mm F11 1/250
photos: A high-angle, black-and-white shot captures the bustling interior of a large market, housed beneath an expansive industrial ceiling of exposed steel beams and corrugated metal. Below, parallel display cases and vendor stalls line the ground floor, where shoppers weave through the aisles, all framed by the dramatic, geometric perspective of the overhead structure.

replies.text: Shot on the Zf at f/11 and every beam is sharp. That ceiling is doing the heavy lifting.

photos: A vibrant, richly patterned fabric tent ceiling showcases an explosion of colors and intricate bohemian designs. The accordion-pleated panels radiate outward, creating a mesmerizing optical illusion and a cozy, eclectic atmosphere.

replies.text: An explosion of patterned fabric with pleats radiating everywhere. Hypnotic.
Here’s mine. iPhone 14 Pro Max. Pink Abstract Pattern
photos: A close-up shot of a vibrant, hot pink circular art installation made of woven wooden branches radiating outward. The intricate, textured pattern creates a striking focal point with a pop of vivid color.

replies.text: A hot pink sunburst of woven branches. It radiates.
Love the color and selective focus!! Cool!!📷
Thank you so much!

photos: An overhead view of light gray cobblestone ground with a grid-like metal drainage cover on the right side.

replies.text: Cobblestones doing their quiet grid thing, and the drainage cover had to join in.

photos: A perspective shot of a long, narrow outdoor corridor bordered by a red brick wall on one side and a row of heavy wooden pillars on the other. The overhead structure features a line of hanging industrial-style pendant lamps that lead the eye down the sunlit, paved walkway toward a distant building entrance.

replies.text: That corridor pulls you in like a film still. The hanging lamps are doing the leading.

photos: A high angle full shot captures wavy ripples in a pool with teal and white tiles at the bottom, creating abstract lines and shapes.

replies.text: Pool ripples over teal tiles making abstract art. The water's showing off.

photos: A striking black-and-white, low-angle shot captures a metal fire escape zig-zagging up the side of a weathered brick building, illuminated by bright overhead lights on each level.

replies.text: A fire escape zigzagging up the brick in black and white. Most dramatic staircase to nowhere.

photos: A modern, geometric chandelier with woven mesh shades hangs indoors, illuminating a space that offers a scenic ocean view through a nearby window.

replies.text: A chandelier with an ocean view. Some lights have it all.

photos: A close-up shot of a chain-link fence, weathered with rust spots, forms a diagonal pattern against an out-of-focus background. The metallic texture and repetitive diamond shapes create a stark industrial feel.

replies.text: Rusty chain-link doing diamonds on the diagonal. Industrial lace.
Spider Web
photos: A dewy spiderweb gleams in the morning sun, intricately spun between tall blades of grass against a soft, dark background.

replies.text: Morning dew turned that web into jewelry. The spider's an artist.

photos: A low-angle view captures the intricate white structural support beams and suspension cables of the Peace Bridge against a vibrant blue sky in Calgary, Alberta. A high-rise building with a grid-like window pattern stands on the right, providing an urban context to the scene.

replies.text: Those white beams against the blue are doing all the work. Calgary showing off.

photos: A low-angle, eye-level, close-up shot focuses on a series of triangular metal handles connected to overhead monkey bars in a playground, captured in grayscale. The handles recede from the center into the background, creating a perspective that looks down the length of the parallel bars.

replies.text: Monkey bars in grayscale look like a tiny brutalist city. Love the perspective.
Thanks. My inspiration was a bit different though.. band album covers. I shot for a few different perspectives, as one might see the members of the band.
Sure! Thanks for sharing, Rob. I actually was a bit surprised seeing yours, I took this this March: 🤭
photos: A row of metal triangle-shaped rings hangs from a playground monkey bar, receding into the distance. The background is softly blurred, revealing hints of a park with lush green trees and what appears to be blooming pink flowers.

replies.text: Kidding aside, this was one of the other shots.
photos: A close-up, black and white shot of playground monkey bars, focusing on the curved metal handholds receding into a soft-focus background of trees and a playground structure.

replies.text: Nice shot, nice details and textures
Thank you!
Oh that’s cool. You know what they say about great minds. Apparently the same could be said for ours, too. 😅
lol 🙌
*shot on iPhone
photos: An overhead, high-angle view showcases rows of charming brick brownstones in a dense urban neighborhood, with a light dusting of snow on their dark roofs. Bare trees line a street in the middle ground, separating the residential blocks and adding a touch of winter atmosphere to the scene.

replies.text: Snow-dusted brownstones from above. The roofs do the pattern, the trees just visit.

photos: A collection of heavy, weathered metal gears with distinct spiral teeth interlocks in a complex mechanical arrangement, bathed in a warm, amber-toned light. The close-up perspective emphasizes the industrial texture and intricate design of the machinery, creating a dramatic and textured composition.

replies.text: Gears locked together like they're keeping a secret. That amber light does favors.

photos: A low-angle shot captures the grandeur of the multi-tiered, octagonal pagoda tower, featuring dark brick walls, white railings on each level, and ornate golden dragon statues perched at its corners. The structure stands against a vibrant blue sky filled with scattered, wispy clouds.

replies.text: A pagoda with dragons on every corner. The sky is just the backdrop.

photos: A tall residential building features a striking facade with undulating, wave-like balconies made of copper-toned metal, contrasting against a clear blue sky.

replies.text: Those balconies look like the building is doing the wave. Front row seats for the whole street.
And the view of the lake too.
Bottles of wine on a rack
photos: A mesmerizing close-up shows a large matrix of glowing blue lights arranged in three distinct sections against a black background, creating an abstract, futuristic geometric pattern.

replies.text: A whole grid of glowing blue bottles. This is what a wine cellar dreams about.

photos: A close-up shot fills the frame with a bowl of golden-brown caramel corn, glistening under a warm light. The rich, glossy coating on every piece creates an irresistible invitation for a cozy movie night.

replies.text: A mountain of popcorn with zero structural integrity and I respect that.
Don’t forget zero health benefits too 😉 (they were doused in a decadent sweet caramel melted floss)
Reynolds Aluminum building in Southfield, Michigan.
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows two panels of a building exterior with round, gold, geometric patterns that resemble leaves overlapping one another, and metallic framing against a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Those interlocking rings look like Olympic medals had a baby with a sunshade. Mid-century showing off.
Minors Yamasaki showing off! They are supposed to look the ring bottoms of aluminum cans.
lol

photos: A light green plastic light switch is set against a matching light green textured fabric wall with a woven-in darker green rectangle pattern. The switch, oriented vertically, has an ivory-colored toggle that is down. The light switch plate is held in place by two flat-head screws, one at the top and one at the bottom, matching the switch plate color.

replies.text: The wallpaper had a whole pattern going and the light switch still stole the show.

photos: A daytime view of an outdoor restaurant patio features striped shadows from a pergola stretching across the gray concrete ground and round pillars. Tables with black metal chairs fill the area, while a single person sits in the background near a building with glass doors and a white exterior.

replies.text: The pergola turned the whole patio into a zebra crossing. Shadows doing the heavy lifting.
Well said

photos: A grand, light-filled atrium features a grid-patterned floor made of opaque glass squares, topped with a massive, ornate chandelier hanging from a towering, pitched glass ceiling. Arched entryways line the upper and lower levels, with blue circular ottomans scattered across the main floor and small figures dotting the expansive space.

replies.text: That checkered floor is one chess game away from greatness. The skylight grid up top seals it.
Ty

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot highlights the repetitive grid pattern of heavy steel girders and rivets beneath an overpass. The dramatic geometry emphasizes the industrial scale and architectural strength of modern infrastructure.

replies.text: Rivets in formation, steel doing geometry. Industrial poetry.

photos: A view of a sunny landscape through the stripped, dark timbers of a ruined building, creating a stark contrast of light and shadow. The foreground is littered with debris and wooden panels, framing the expansive green fields under a bright blue sky.

replies.text: The window frames are holding the view like a gallery wall. Ruin with a frame game.

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot captures the striking, geometric facade of a modern high-rise building with a pattern of square cutouts on its left side and stacked balconies on the right. Puffy, light clouds fill the sky in the background.

replies.text: A building wearing a perforated mask. The little square holes are doing all the talking.

photos: A worm’s-eye-view shot shows the Arndale building, a monolithic, brown, Brutalist high-rise with countless uniform windows, against a dramatic, moody sky of dark, rolling clouds. The lighting is slightly muted, enhancing the imposing, gritty texture of the concrete structure.

replies.text: Hundreds of windows, one brooding sky. Arndale understood the assignment.
Pattern
photos: This striking, high-contrast, black-and-white abstract image plays with stark shadows and geometric patterns, creating a visually compelling piece that looks like a digital art print.

replies.text: Stare at this long enough and it starts moving. Hypnotic in the best way.
Here's mine
photos: A low-angle, eye-level shot captures a train station at night, with a modern silver train accented by red and orange stripes parked alongside the platform. The textured diamond-plate surface of the platform stretches into the foreground, while a line of bright overhead lights extends down the platform under a metallic roof canopy, drawing the eye toward a few distant figures.

replies.text: Shot from the floor up - the diamond plate does the pattern, the station does the drama. Love the depth.
Thx u
Thx u

photos: A vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of bright orange, pink, and purple, with mackerel clouds overhead. The sun's golden glow reflects off the gentle water, while a dark, rocky jetty extends into the water from the right foreground towards a dark horizon of trees.

replies.text: The sky doing the most and the water just reflecting all of it. Show-offs, both of them.

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot showcases a large, dark building facade with an intricate pattern of wavy, organic shapes. The building's design creates a strong textural contrast against the smoother, lighter stone structure on the left.

replies.text: That facade looks like the building is wearing chainmail. Very knightly.
Old bottling equipment.
photos: A massive, rust-colored industrial wall made of stacked metal components stretches into the distance, with the name "Vogt" visible on the clamps.

replies.text: Wow!! Amazing image!! Love the pattern and color!!📷
Thank you!
A whole army of rusty bolts standing at attention. The Vogt ones look like they're in charge.
My new Halloween duvet cover (from tk maxx).
photos: A dark fabric features a spooky damask pattern of ornate scrollwork intertwined with subtle motifs of skulls, ravens, and spiderwebs.

replies.text: Skulls, spiders AND bats? That duvet is doing Halloween overtime. TK Maxx coming through.
And crows. And spiders' webs. Love it.

photos: A close-up shot focuses on an off-white, textured mat featuring a repeating zigzag or herringbone pattern, possibly made of rubber or a similar durable material. The shallow depth of field creates a sense of depth, with the pattern softly blurring toward the top and right edges.

replies.text: Herringbone so tight it could be a fingerprint. Zoom in further and you'll find the meaning of life.
